overview: Forest Heartlands is the corrupted interior of Grimling Forest, where Acrylia influence twists roots, wildlife, and forest spirits.
history: The Heartlands were once the sacred center of the forest.
Acrylia corruption seeped into the roots after crystal veins erupted.
Grimling shamans began performing rituals to harness forest spirits.
Burrow tunnels collapsed, spreading corruption through root networks.
A forest spirit became corrupted and now haunts the Heartlands.
hooks: A corrupted forest spirit awakens deeper in the Heartlands.
Grimling shamans attempt a massive ritual.
Acrylia veins spread into the deep groves.
Burrow creatures erupt from corrupted root tunnels.
